frontend.installCommand: while [ ! -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done && bash scripts/vercel-run.sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
frontend.buildCommand: while [ ! -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done && bash scripts/vercel-run.sh node_modules/.bin/turbo run build --filter=@sellmanager/web

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.public.blob.vercel-storage.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

backend.installCommand: while [ ! -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done && bash scripts/vercel-run.sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
backend.buildCommand: while [ ! -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done && bash scripts/vercel-run.sh bash apps/api/scripts/vercel-build.sh
